description: This PHP source file contains functions related to generating and managing test specifications and coverage views within the TestLink testing management system. It includes methods for building test suite and test case trees, filtering test cases by various criteria, adding linked version information, and pruning empty or unlinked test suites to produce structured data used in the user interface.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: A class managing test case operations, including retrieval of test case versions, filtering, and related metadata.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: A class managing platform data, including retrieval of available platforms and those linked to test plans.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: A class managing test plan data, including retrieval of linked test case versions and keywords.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class managing test project data, including hierarchy management, node retrieval, and keyword filtering.

methods.name: getTestSpecFromNode
methods.description: Retrieves the subtree of test cases and test suites starting from a specific node, applying optional filters and ordering.

methods.name: getPlatforms
methods.description: Retrieves a list of platforms associated with a test project or test plan.

methods.name: addLinkedVersionsInfo
methods.description: Enhances test case version data with linked version information, including execution details and statuses.

methods.name: removeEmptyTestSuites
methods.description: Removes test suites from a set that contain no test cases or are unlinked if pruning is enabled.

methods.name: removeEmptyBranches
methods.description: Prunes empty branches in the test suite tree based on the accumulated count of test cases.

methods.name: addCustomFieldsToView
methods.description: Adds custom field data to test suite view elements, especially for linked test case versions.

methods.name: buildSkeleton
methods.description: Constructs a hierarchical structure of test suites and test cases for display, linking parent-child relationships.

methods.name: buildSkeletonFlat
methods.description: Builds a flat structured list of test suites and test cases, suitable for indexed display.
